paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the proportion of harmful responses in which the model exhibited a rejection tendency, measured as the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," across different model configurations and datasets. The x-axis represents the number of training examples, with values at 128, 256, 512, and 1024, plotted on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. Four distinct lines represent different model and dataset combinations: "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" (blue circles), "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep" (orange squares), "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench" (green triangles), and "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" (red diamonds). All lines show an increasing trend as the number of training examples increases. At 128 examples, the "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" line starts at approximately 0.24, while "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" starts at 0.20, "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep" at 0.15, and "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench" at 0.06. By 1024 examples, the "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" line reaches a value of 0.52, "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep" reaches 0.42, "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench" reaches 0.38, and "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" reaches 0.36. The "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" line consistently remains above the others across all data points.
